t: An instruction to go out and use it
a: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
p: Huwa-lladhī jaʿala lakumu-l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-mshū fī manākibihā wa kulū min rizqih…
m: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
